Company books and reconciliation

You may record actual sales, purchases, inventory, jobs, time and journal entries. Check quantities, dates, postings, adjustments and reconciliations against invoices, bank statements and other source documents. The bank CSV tools exchange files. They do not move money or obtain a bank’s confirmation. You are responsible for the books you approve, the reports you issue and keeping supporting records for as long as required.

Payroll worksheets

The current federal worksheet estimates selected 2026 withholding and payroll taxes from the information entered. It does not produce final payroll, pay stubs, direct deposits or tax filings. Use an independently verified payroll process for wages, overtime, state and local obligations, deposits and filings. Using FirmQuill does not appoint the publisher as your accountant, payroll agent or tax adviser.

Your records and backups

All companies in a browser profile share one encrypted vault. Someone who unlocks it can access the companies it contains. Keep the password and separate, tested .firmquill backups. A backup carries every company and its attachments. Review the destination before transferring or restoring it. Clearing site data can remove the browser copy, and downloaded statements and printouts may be readable outside the vault.
